suggested_requirements.text: The system shall provide a web-based interface for user access.
The system shall require users to enter a unique user name and password to access the system.
The system shall restrict access privileges based on the user's job classification.
The system shall allow administrators to view or edit all account information.
The system shall allow administrators to check classroom availability.
The system shall place children on a waiting list if their age group's classroom is full.
The system shall allow administrators to create or edit customer accounts.
The system shall allow teaching assistants to record child arrival and departure times.
The system shall maintain a record of authorized pick-up persons for each child.
The system shall allow teachers to document and store child behavior comments.
The system shall allow administrators to generate and print customer reports and invoices.
The system shall include an immunization notice on invoices if a child is due for a required immunization.
The system shall bill customers on the last day of every month.
The system shall allow employees to create and manage daily reminders.
The system shall display a pop-up reminder message when an employee logs in on the reminder date.
The system shall allow teachers and assistants to enter or edit child comments and arrival/departure times.
The system shall allow administrators to enter or edit all data.
The system shall lock out users after three unsuccessful password attempts.
The system shall allow users to reset forgotten passwords.
The system shall log off users after 10 minutes of inactivity.
The system shall store immunization dates and physical examination dates in a child's record.
The system shall display a notification to teachers when a child is within two weeks of a required immunization.
The system shall calculate and apply discounts for multiple children enrolled in the same account.
The system shall calculate late pick-up fees at $10 per hour per child.
The system shall record the user ID, date, time, and description of changes when an account is edited.
The system shall store customer log notes regarding correspondence with parents.
The system shall enforce a maximum capacity of 20 children per classroom.
The system shall store a waiting list of up to 100 potential customers.
Passwords shall contain 6 to 8 alphanumeric characters.
The system shall have a web-based interface compatible with Internet Explorer and Netscape Navigator.
The background color of all windows shall be blue.
The system shall respond to all user requests within 20 seconds.
The system shall use Microsoft ASP.NET technology.
